name: BrainRotGuard
description: YouTube approval system for kids. Your child searches YouTube via a kid-friendly web UI, you get a Telegram notification with thumbnail and details, tap Approve or Deny, and approved videos play via privacy-enhanced embeds. Includes channel allow/block lists, daily watch time limits, scheduled access windows, category labeling, and search history tracking. Pair with DNS blocking (Pi-hole/AdGuard) for full control.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Stores the SQLite database (watch history, approvals, channel lists).

paths.name: Config File (optional)
paths.description: Optional: mount a custom config.yaml for advanced settings. Leave empty to configure entirely via environment variables.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the BrainRotGuard web interface.

variables.name: Telegram Admin Chat ID
variables.description: Your Telegram numeric chat ID. Send /start to @userinfobot to find it.

variables.name: PIN Code
variables.description: Optional PIN to protect the web UI. Leave empty for no PIN.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: LAN URL for Telegram deep links (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080). Auto-detected if empty.

variables.name: Daily Watch Limit (minutes)
variables.description: Daily screen time limit in minutes. 0 = unlimited.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for daily limit resets and scheduled access windows (e.g. America/Chicago, Europe/London).
